verdict.rationale: Cooley GO publishes a free YC Safe document generator covering several SAFE versions in US, UK and Singapore variants. It also offers a Series Seed equity financing package for priced seed rounds. Cooley states a large emerging-companies practice handling 2,100+ VC financings a year, so the story's forms and stated early-stage practice are both directly documented. Missing for 10: evidence of convertible-note forms or explainers beyond SAFEs, SAFE-specific published explainer articles (the guidance hub is only referenced generically), and independent corroboration specific to Cooley's SAFE work.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice
